dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Adds concrete expert formulas (partition‑key cardinality calculator, GSI cost multiplier, adaptive‑capacity window) and specific numeric thresholds (10 000 distinct values, 30 s borrow window) that a generic model would not provide. Some sections merely restate common best‑practices, so not a full 20.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Provides a detailed 10‑step provisioning workflow, exact ordering of immutable decisions, and AWS‑specific CLI commands for each step. A few steps (e.g., generic "Enable Streams") are less AWS‑specific, costing one point.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a thorough "NEVER" list (12 items) with explicit reasoning and real‑world consequences. Missing a few niche pitfalls (e.g., KMS request‑rate limits) prevents a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter is complete (name, description, version, keywords, tags, metadata, triggers). The description clearly states WHAT the skill does, WHEN to invoke, and KEYWORDS. Output format is precisely defined with required literal labels.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: The document is very dense; many detailed heuristics and tables appear before the core checklist, which can overload the agent. A more staged presentation (high‑level summary first, then deep tables) would improve layering.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Calibrates tightly for fragile operations (create‑table, immutable settings) and relaxes for creative design decisions (key‑schema brainstorming). Only minor looseness: capacity‑mode decision tree could allow on‑demand for steady high‑throughput without a cost warning.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable structure (activation → contract → mindset → reasoning → heuristics → anti‑patterns → output format → examples → decision tree → error handling). Minor ad‑hoc ordering of heuristics before the NEVER list prevents a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides working examples that obey the contract, decision trees, CLI commands, and error‑handling guidance. Slight deduction for not explicitly covering the edge case of a pre‑existing table with mismatched immutable schema (though error handling touches it).
